breakdowns.sentence: The weather in Nebraska has been so warm, but today, as you can see from my red nose, it's a little bit cold.
breakdowns.translation: 內布拉斯加的天氣一直很暖和，但今天，從我的紅鼻子你也看得出來，有一點冷。

points.label: 現在完成式
points.text: has/have + 過去分詞；疑問句把 has/have 放到主詞前
points.note: 用來連結過去到現在的狀態或經驗，so far 也常和現在完成式一起出現。

breakdowns.sentence: Though it's previously been worn, it's still really good quality.
breakdowns.translation: 雖然它以前被穿過，但品質還是很好。

points.label: 現在完成式被動語態
points.note: 重點是衣服曾經被穿過，不是誰穿過它，所以用被動語態。

breakdowns.sentence: Some of my friends' parents would always work all year round.
breakdowns.translation: 我有些朋友的父母以前總是一整年都在工作。

points.label: would 表過去習慣
points.note: 用 would 描述過去常常發生的習慣或反覆狀況。

breakdowns.sentence: What I enjoyed the most about living in the United States, specifically Nebraska, was the seasons.
breakdowns.translation: 我在美國，尤其是內布拉斯加，生活時最喜歡的是季節。

points.label: what 名詞子句作主詞
points.text: What + 主詞 + 動詞 + the most + be + 補語
points.note: 把最喜歡的事情整體放在主詞位置，再用 was 說出答案。

breakdowns.sentence: Even though winter here is super intense, the gorgeous summers make it all worth it.
breakdowns.translation: 雖然這裡的冬天非常嚴酷，美麗的夏天讓一切都值得。

points.label: even though 讓步副詞子句
points.text: even though + 子句, 主句
points.note: 先承認不好的情況，再說主要結論仍然成立。

breakdowns.sentence: There's too much here to eat, and it's so easy to eat everything, especially since I never get to eat it in Mexico.
breakdowns.translation: 這裡可以吃的東西太多了，而且什麼都很容易吃下去，尤其是因為我在墨西哥從來吃不到。

points.label: too much + to V
points.text: too much + 名詞或地點內容 + to + 原形動詞
points.note: 表示數量很多，可以做某事，這裡是有太多東西可以吃。

breakdowns.sentence: Your home country is where you were born and raised.
breakdowns.translation: 你的祖國就是你出生和長大的地方。

points.label: 被動語態共用助動詞
points.text: were + 過去分詞 and 過去分詞
points.note: born 和 raised 都是過去分詞，共用同一個 were，意思是你被生下來並被養大。

breakdowns.sentence: So, if you're interested in learning Spanish, go check out my new TikTok account.
breakdowns.translation: 所以，如果你對學西班牙語有興趣，去看看我的新 TikTok 帳號。

points.label: be interested in + V-ing
points.note: in 是介系詞，後面要接動名詞 learning，而不是原形動詞 learn。
